seed.text: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition follows Carl "CJ" Johnson as he returns to Los Santos after his mother's murder. Reunited with his brother Sweet and the Grove Street Families, CJ becomes entangled in gang rivalries, police corruption, betrayal, and organized crime. His journey takes him across the massive state of San Andreas, from the streets of Los Santos to the countryside, San Fierro, and the neon-lit casinos of Las Venturas. Gameplay combines open-world exploration, third-person shooting, driving, gang warfare, and a wide variety of missions. Players can customize CJ's appearance, build muscle and stamina, improve weapon and driving skills, purchase properties, recruit gang members, and take control of rival territories. The game also features vehicle customization, street races, stealth missions, aircraft, helicopters, and numerous side activities.
